scope: live Supabase REST, public.shots, all projects; read-only SELECT
classification_rule: complete iff frames.start, frames.direction, and frames.end are all non-empty strings; no_frames iff JSON is non-null but frames is absent/non-object; null iff column is null; partial iff frames exists but not all three keys are non-empty.
caveat: No project/shot identifiers are retained here. Counts describe the snapshot only; no writes were issued. The 176 no_frames rows may be legacy single-image records or other non-frame JSON and require row-level review to distinguish.
